armiesOfRenown.lore:
The Beastclaw Raiders are ogors who follow the old ways with thuggish devotion. In their eyes, everything ‘modern’ ogors value – prestige and infamy amongst the thinlings, strongholds stacked high with plunder, the ‘Great Secret’ of mercenary work – is a corruption. Theirs was the way long before other ogors began willingly embracing atavism.

When you pick the Ogor Mawtribes faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Beastclaw Alfrostun Army of Renown. armiesOfRenown.name: Mawseeker Gollop
armiesOfRenown.lore:
Coated with gore and the heady stink of fanaticism, the Mawseekers most completely embody the ogor god’s brute creed: that existence itself is meat to be feasted upon. Yet if there is something apocalyptic in their beliefs, the ogors do not seem to notice. They exude what can only be described as a monstrous bonhomie as they go about their gluttonous atrocities, for they see the current era of woe as a time of plenty: a gift from their god and a challenge that they – and by extension the ogor race in its entirety – must rise to meet.

rules.name: Trampling Charge
rules.phaseDetails: Any Charge Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

rules.name: Tasty Morsels
rules.phaseDetails: Passive
rules.effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly **Mawpit**’s ‘Hungry Sinkhole’ ability, you gain 1 **tasty morsel**.

rules.name: Mawpits of Ghur
rules.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
rules.effect:
Roll 2D6 and add the number of **tasty morsels** you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your **tasty morsels** to 0.

**2-3 – *Subdued*:**
No effect.

**4-5 – *Peckish*:**
Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits**.

**6-8 – *Rumbling*:**
Roll a dice for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

**9-11 – *Famished*:**
Units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits** cannot use commands.

**12+ – *Ravenous*:**
Roll a D3 for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

rules.name: The Realm Hungers
rules.phaseDetails: Passive
rules.effect: Units and **MANIFESTATIONS** are **vulnerable** **to Mawpits** while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a **Mawpit**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **FLY**.

artefacts.name: Flasks of Congealed Maw-juices
artefacts.effect: Friendly **Mawpits** within this unit’s combat range have **WARD** **(5+)**.

heroicTraits.name: Prime Gutserver
heroicTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
heroicTraits.effect: If this unit is within 1" of a friendly **Mawpit**, gain 1 **tasty morsel**.

spells.name: Mawmeat
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: For the rest of the battle, units on or within 1" of the target are **vulnerable to Mawpits**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **FLY**.

spells.name: Retcher
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: Add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the caster’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Fortifying Hoarfrost
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.

spells.name: Freezing Tailwinds
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. Add 2 instead if the chanting roll was 6+.

spells.name: Pulverising Hailstorm
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
spells.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Then, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target(s).

spells.name: Tallowflage
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.

spells.name: Blood Feast
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

spells.name: Shincruncher
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
spells.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move or is set up on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the ability has been resolved.

**Designer’s Note**: *The ‘Bull Charge’ ability in the battle traits forces an enemy unit to move.*

artefacts.name: Trophy Rack
artefacts.effect:
Pick 1 of the following trophies. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used by other friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units have the corresponding weapon ability while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit:

• ***Squeezed Head***: **Anti‑MONSTER (+1 Rend)**

• ***Smashed City Rubble***: **Anti‑WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**

• ***Torn Appendages***: **Anti‑CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**

artefacts.name: Carvalox Hide
artefacts.effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**. It also has **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

artefacts.name: Mantle of Entrails
artefacts.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
artefacts.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
artefacts.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

artefacts.name: A Choice Cut
artefacts.effect:
• This unit cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit each phase while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

artefacts.name: Rusty Grater
artefacts.effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

artefacts.name: Key to the Larder
artefacts.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit on the battlefield to be the target.
artefacts.effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Leave Not a Morsel
heroicTraits.effect: While they are within 6" of and visible to this unit, enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them.

heroicTraits.name: Dreaded Far and Wide
heroicTraits.effect:
Ignore negative modifiers to:

• This unit’s control score.
• Hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s non‑**Companion** attacks.
• Charge rolls for this unit.
• The number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit.

heroicTraits.name: The Crusherguts
heroicTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain and the target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

other.name: Extremely Obstinate
other.effect: This unit has a Control characteristic of 15.

other.name: Horn Toss
other.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model, that is in combat with this unit and that has charged this turn to be the target.
other.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

other.name: Grumpy Alpha
other.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick another visible friendly **OGOR MONSTER** wholly within 12" of this unit that is not in combat to be the target.
other.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll a dice. The target can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can end that move in combat. If it does so, the target has charged.

other.name: Gutslugger
other.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks if it did not charge in the same turn.

other.name: Megagobbler
other.effect:
Pick 1 of the following keywords:

• **INFANTRY**
• **CAVALRY**
• **MONSTER**
• **WAR MACHINE**
• **BEAST**

For the rest of the battle, each time any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit with that keyword by this unit’s combat attacks and that enemy unit is destroyed in the same turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. This effect is cumulative.

other.name: Mage-swallower
other.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

other.name: Along the Icepaths
other.declare: Pick the **Huskard on Stonehorn** in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick up to 3 visible friendly units wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a chanting roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if the friendly **Thundertusk Beastriders** unit in this Regiment of Renown is wholly within 12" of this unit.
other.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
•  Add 3 to run rolls for each target.
•  Each target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
•  Each time a target uses a **RETREAT** ability, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

other.name: Cling on Tight
other.effect: Each time the **Thundertusk Beastriders** unit in this Regiment of Renown uses the ‘Plough the Icepath’ ability, you can pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that has not been reinforced, is wholly within 6" of that **Thundertusk Beastriders** unit and has not been set up this turn to be the target instead of a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit.

other.name: We'll Be There - If The Pay's Right
other.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.
other.effect: Set up the targets in reserve **preparing a flank attack**. They have now been deployed.

other.name: The Horns Hit Home
other.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
other.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is **preparing a flank attack** to be the targets.
other.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Eat 'Em Alive
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability that targeted a unit, excluding **FACTION TERRAIN**, this turn to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
battleTraits.effect:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly **OGOR** unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect.

• ***Raw and Bloody Flesh***: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit.

• ***Exotic Giblets***: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks made with non‑**Companion** weapons.

• ***Steaming Brains***: Add 2 to that unit’s Control characteristic.

• ***Crunchy Bones***: That unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**. If that unit’s melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** instead.

• ***Slick Innards***: That unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

• ***Mystery Meat***: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0.

**Designer’s Note**: *Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.*

battleTraits.name: Bull Charge
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat.

After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a **GUTBUSTERS** unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile‑in move.

**Designer’s Note**: *Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.*

battleTraits.name: Jaws of the Beast
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTCLAW HERO** that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-**HERO** unit in that **HERO**'s regiment that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up those units in reserve **tracking the prey**. They have now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Closing the Jaws
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTCLAW HERO** that is **tracking the prey**.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that **HERO** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is **tracking the prey** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that **HERO** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
